story.body: You played the opening and the close, and came off to the reckoning.

participation.context: Took six-and-twenty into his purse, left the coffer shut, and named nine o'clock.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Told the share, and named Monday at two as The Shrew.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Asked to have his counted twice, and stayed on you.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Counted the same pile, and went for the gate.
participation.name: George Bryan

participation.context: Called it a Saturday, not a fortune.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Asked after the Rose, and named Monday's bill again on the way out.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.quote: Here is the first share since July on the cloth. Count your own: six-and-twenty shillings to each man.

story.body: You counted your share, named Monday's bill as Heminges had it, and kept the coffer at the figure you ruled on the twenty-second.

relations.quote: Here is the first share since July on the cloth. Count your own: six-and-twenty shillings to each man.

title: Took six-and-twenty shillings and named Monday's Shrew
